commands: echo "GITHUB_ACTIONS=${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-unset}"; echo "GITHUB_RUN_ID=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-unset}"; echo "CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR=${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR:-unset}"; ls -d .prflow/vendor/prflow 2>/dev/null || echo "no vendor"; git branch --show-current; git status --porcelain | head
printenv GITHUB_ACTIONS GITHUB_RUN_ID 2>/dev/null; echo "---branch---"; git branch --show-current; echo "---status---"; git status --porcelain

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow
BASE=$(.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/config-get.sh .base_branch main) || BASE=""
[ -n "$BASE" ] || BASE=main
CUR=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null) || CUR=""
COMMON_DIR=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null) || COMMON_DIR=""
GIT_DIR_PATH=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir 2>/dev/null) || GIT_DIR_PATH=""
echo "BASE=$BASE CUR=$CUR COMMON_DIR=$COMMON_DIR GIT_DIR_PATH=$GIT_DIR_PATH"

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow; echo "=== AC4 ===" && python3 lib/test/cloud-writer-retention-check.py . && echo rc=$?; echo "=== AC5 ==="; python3 lib/test/lint-shipped-pruned-path.py && echo "pruned rc=$?"; python3 lib/test/lint-anchor-fallback-arm.py && echo "anchor rc=$?"; python3 lib/test/lint-reference-size.py && echo "refsize rc=$?"; echo "=== contract json changed? ==="; git diff --stat origin/main -- scripts/devflow-cloud-writer-contract.json

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow
echo "=== growth ==="; scripts/prompt-surface-growth.py 2>&1
echo "=== workpad ==="; WID=$(scripts/workpad.py id 1422 2>/dev/null || true); echo "WID=$WID"; [ -n "$WID" ] && scripts/workpad.py body "$WID" 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'post-merge|## Acceptance' || echo "(no post-merge items)"
echo "=== deferrals ==="; ls -la .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1857/deferrals.json 2>/dev/null || echo "(no deferrals file)"

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
